messages:
Priya (CS): quick heads-up — we want to run a CRM hygiene pulse in staging today to measure healthscore drift before the larger backfill. planning a dedupe + stale-contact prune dry-run. who can own the staging job?
Liam - DataEng: I can kick it off. will run a sampled dedupe (0.5%) on the staging mirror at 12:30 PST. job id: stg-dedupe-20240412-01
Adele (Enablement): thanks — i can run the eval harness against our onboarding + renewal prompt set after the run. want the health delta and a short summary for CS weekly.
Zach - Platform: hold for 15m — noticed a schema tweak in the contact_props branch that affects last_touch indexing. i'll deploy the index patch to staging now. if the dedupe reads old index we could double-delete.
Priya (CS): good catch @Zach - please post when index patch is live. if it lands, Liam, can you requeue the run?
Zach - Platform: index patch deployed. CI passed. build: platform-index-0.9.2 ✅
Liam - DataEng: requeued job -> stg-dedupe-20240412-02. sampling: 0.5%, seed=1729. ETA ~18m. pinging cs-bot to capture telemetry.
cs-bot: automated test results for stg-dedupe-20240412-02: 3 checks passed, 1 warning (contact.email null-rate high in cohort B). Full log: https://ci.internal/logs/stg-dedupe-20240412-02
Adele (Enablement): warning noted — i'll exclude cohort B from the evaluation set to avoid noise, will report separately.
Maya (CS Ops): rollback plan in case of regression: pause playbook triggers for 1 hour, revert the backfill job, restore contact status from snapshot stg-snap-20240412-00. also adding an alert to the healthscore monitor (delta > 0.05 triggers).
Priya (CS): perfect. Adele — can you add a short checklist for the Friday sync? we want: run summary, top 3 deltas, any false positive deletions, and recommendation (go/no-go).
Adele (Enablement): on it. i'll draft in #enablement-docs and tag this thread.
Liam - DataEng: run completed. summary: scanned 1.2M staging rows, candidate dedupes ~2.3%, actual deletions in sample 0.08%. healthscore change (sample) => mean -0.012, median -0.004. attaching small csv -> https://artifacts/internal/stg-dedupe-20240412-02/summary.csv
Priya (CS): ok looks small, but want to validate churned contacts aren't active trials. Maya, can you run a quick cross-check on trial_state for deletions?
Maya (CS Ops): cross-check done — 0 contacts in sample were active trial. no red flags.
Priya (CS): great. next steps: Adele to run eval harness, we keep playbook triggers paused until we get the full health delta from prod-sim. if all green, plan a limited backfill next Tuesday. tagging @here so eng-sre & legal know. :thumbsup:
cs-bot: reminder: please file a post-run ops note with job id and snapshots -> /ops/notes/stg-dedupe-20240412-02.txt
Priya (CS): thanks everyone — moving this to the Friday sync agenda.
